step_or_reason: Step 1: Obtain Active SF Rent Increase License
rule_requirement: Report both units annually in the SF Rent Board Housing Inventory (portal.sfrb.org, due March 1) and download active Rent Increase License BEFORE serving or making effective any annual or banked increase.
verified_value: Active license required prior to effective date
lawyer_safe_guidance: Attach a copy of the current Rent Increase License (or record the license number and portal confirmation date in the notice file) so tenant counsel sees immediate compliance.

rule_requirement: Confirm lease is month-to-month (or fixed term has expired) under Cal. Civ. Code § 827, and at least 12 full months have elapsed since initial move-in or last annual rent increase.
verified_value: >=12 months spacing & no unexpired fixed term
lawyer_safe_guidance: Check the April 1, 2026 Unit 1 agreement first; if fixed-term through March 31, 2027, calendar Unit 1's notice for fixed-term expiration.

step_or_reason: Step 3: State Exact Unrounded Dollar & Percentage Figures
rule_requirement: Written notice must specify current lawful base rent, exact dollar increase (never rounded up), exact percentage increase based on the effective-date rate, new monthly base rent, and effective date.
verified_value: Exact cents (no rounding up); effective-date rate
official_source_label: SF.gov — Learn About Rent Increases in SF

step_or_reason: Step 4: Itemize Any Banked Portion Explicitly
rule_requirement: If any part of the increase uses banked prior years, SF Rent Board Topic 503 requires stating in writing which portion is the current annual increase and which portion is banked.
verified_value: Written breakdown of current % vs. banked %
lawyer_safe_guidance: List each banked anniversary period and percentage separately and sum them additively (never compound year-over-year).

step_or_reason: Step 5A: Service of Increase <= 10% in 12 Months
rule_requirement: Personal delivery to tenant(s) at least 30 calendar days before effective date, OR first-class U.S. mail within California under CCP § 1013 at least 35 calendar days (30 + 5) before effective date.
lawyer_safe_guidance: CA Attorney General confirms phone calls, texts, and emails are NOT valid legal notice; serve formal signed paper notice and retain Proof of Service + USPS Certificate of Mailing.
official_source_label: CA Dept. of Justice (Attorney General) — Tenant Rights

step_or_reason: Step 5B: Service of Increase > 10% in 12 Months
rule_requirement: If the increase alone or combined with prior increases within 12 months exceeds 10% (such as Unit 2's 13.1% full banked scenario), Cal. Civ. Code § 827(b)(3) mandates 90 days personal delivery OR 95 days (90 + 5) if mailed in CA.
lawyer_safe_guidance: Watch the February 28, 2027 rate boundary: a 95-day mailed notice served after November 25, 2026 lands in March 2027, changing the applicable Rent Board rate cycle.

step_or_reason: Reason 1 (Recommended): Routine Annual CPI-Indexed Allowance (SF Admin Code § 37.3(a)(1))
rule_requirement: The SF Rent Ordinance sets the annual allowable increase at 60% of Bay Area CPI-U specifically to balance general inflation and routine operating expenses with tenant stability.
lawyer_safe_guidance: Recommended neutral phrasing: 'Routine annual allowable rent adjustment pursuant to SF Administrative Code § 37.3(a)(1) for the 3/1/2026–2/28/2027 Rent Board cycle.' No further subjective narrative is needed.

step_or_reason: Reason 2: Lawfully Banked Prior Annual Allowances (SF Admin Code § 37.3(a)(2))
rule_requirement: Permitted where >=24 full months elapsed without an increase, allowing partial or full recovery of skipped annual CPI allowances.
lawyer_safe_guidance: If used on Unit 2, consider a modest partial banked adjustment (or 1.6% current only) and state the exact historical years objectively without blaming tenants.

step_or_reason: Reason 3: Pre-Certified Capital Improvement / O&M / Bond Passthroughs
rule_requirement: Exceeding the annual + banked AGA for roof/window renovations, spiked property tax/insurance (O&M), or G.O./Water bonds is lawful ONLY via Rent Board petition/worksheet approval BEFORE notice.
lawyer_safe_guidance: Note O&M + Capital Improvement cap limits and tenant Financial Hardship Application rights; never cite taxes/insurance to exceed 1.6% without an approved Rent Board filing.

step_or_reason: Impermissible Reasons (Roommate Change / Repairs / Market Comps)
rule_requirement: Raising rent because Tenant 1D moved in, because a tenant requested repairs, to match Zillow/market rents, or to pressure a move-out violates SF Rent Ordinance, Cal. Civ. Code § 1942.5, and SF Admin Code § 37.10B.
lawyer_safe_guidance: Never mention roommates, repair costs, utility usage, or market rents in any notice, email, or text message to either unit.
